chapter: Reflections on Paris guitarists and saxophonists
title: Charlie Christian and Oscar Ellman compared
summary: Butler never heard Charlie Christian live but says Ellman, whom he heard personally, was fantastic and would have excited Christian.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Before we commence talking about Mr. Butler's adventures in Canada, I'd like to get you to talk a bit about Charlie Christian and Oscar.
Well, I haven't heard from Charlie Christian because when I come back to America, Charlie Christian had passed away.
But from those records that I have heard, he was fantastic.
However, Oscar Ellman, I heard him personally. He is the most fantastic, if he's not, he's still fantastic. Now, you've got some guitar players in Italy who you better be very careful of.

They are something else. Because, after all, these people, they are old world people. Segovia, they listen to him. He's the greatest of them in the world. Because they have the classic -- they do many things.

Charlie Christian was one who is the greatest jazz guitarists I've heard, but Oscar Ellman, he would have excited Charlie Christian. Even from listening to Oscar Ellman and Oscar Ellman would have been listening to him too, so, they would, they would like each other very much.
